method: Worked from prims.pkl (l30) for the box x 11..31, y -58..-29.5. (1) Listed every INSERT in the box at any depth: 7 A-DOOR door blocks plus the nested 2501_Curtain Wall Dbl Glass block in the linked facade model, plus chairs/tables, casework and a plant; dumped the full primitive set of each door block (jamb frames, leaf, arc) and the wall outlines at each end, to get each opening at the wall end faces (frames included), with centre lines from the wall hatch/outline extents. (2) Grouped every non-furniture entity in the box by layer and handle and merged the A-WALL/S-COLS hatch polygons (shapely) to list all wall parts and all free wall ends; every free end and every gap between wall ends on one line was checked: found two doorless gaps (x=14.868 pantry, x=13.167 lift lobby) and the lift 3 landing gap, and rejected corridor mouths, wall-to-glass junctions and wall returns. Checked arcs in other layers (only facade fin tips), the layer linetypes (dashed A-DETL lines at the lobby gap) and the facade panel families (2501_WT-01 curtain wall, WT-05-balustrade). (3) Rendered the whole part once (--grid 1 --inserts) and then 24 tiles of 5 x 5 m (--grid 0.5 --inserts --px 2000): x 11-16, 16-21, 21-26, 26-31, each for y -29.5..-34.5, -34.5..-39.5, -39.5..-44.5, -44.5..-49.5, -49.5..-54.5, -54.5..-58, and looked at all of them; plus a lift-core tile (x 8.5-14.5, y -46.5..-41, tile_core_lifts.png). (4) Final check: marks_full.png and marks_zoom_corridor.png with a marker at the centre of every listed opening; no wall gap, swing, leaf, sliding track or door block is left without a marker. Scripts are in the work/ subfolder.
